newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHERINGHAM-SHEARER PARTNERSHIP GIVES ENGLAND 2-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHERINGHAM-SHEARER PARTNERSHIP GIVES ENGLAND 2-0 WIN.

text.p: Teddy Sheringham and Alan Shearer resumed their partnership by scoring a goal each as England beat Georgia 2-0 in a group two World Cup qualifier at Wembley on Wednesday.
The two forwards had not played together since the European championship last June when they scored seven goals between them to become the tournament's most potent striking force.

Sheringham, who scored against Georgia in Tbilisi last November before missing the 1-0 home defeat by Italy in February through injury, put England in front, heading home a cross from Shearer three minutes before halftime.
Shearer added the second in second-half injury time, blasting home a shot after Sheringham had back-heeled the ball to him from an indirect free-kick six metres out.

England had controlled most of the first period but Georgia, still seeking their first points of the campaign, fought back strongly after the break, captain Kakhi Tskhadadze grazing the crossbar with a shot.
